import os
from pathlib import Path
import collections
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace')
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p=progdir/'task-ff616c6f.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            panels.append([grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)])
    counts = collections.Counter(v for panel in panels for v in panel)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    idx = 0
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        row_out=[]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            panel=panels[idx]; idx += 1
            fg_count=sum(v != background for v in panel)
            row_out.append(1 if fg_count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
